issue.title: Switching to a channel needs no new deep read
issue.body:
Size M · STORY-1 · after #30

**Why.** STORY-1. A channel not drawn yet, or one marked "needs update", is
drawn from the facts alone. The repository is not read again. In 0.2 this
applies to the LinkedIn channel; README and presentation are drawn from 0.3.

**Done when.**
- An empty or out-of-date LinkedIn channel offers to draw or redraw itself,
  and an out-of-date one also "Keep as it is", which clears the mark.
- With an engine, LinkedIn is drawn by the story run from the facts.
  - The prompt carries the facts and asks for no repository reading.
  - If the engine can run with no tools at all, it does. Otherwise it stays
    read-only, as today (invariant 2).
- Without an engine, LinkedIn uses #30's path.
- A redraw replaces the channel and keeps nothing stale. It is one undo step.
- The fake-CLI adapter test shows the story prompt holds the facts and no
  instruction to read files.
- The independent author adds STORY-1 scenarios with the fixture engine. No
  real-engine claim is made from them.


---

**After #25.**
- `channel-draw` (empty LinkedIn) and `channel-redraw` (outdated LinkedIn) are on the stage (ui contract, *Channels*); `channel-keep` comes with #29.
- A redraw empties the channel's `outdated` and is one undo step.
